SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fin_bill WHERE partner_id = #{id} AND kind = 'AP') THEN '应付单' WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fin_invoice WHERE partner_id = #{id} AND kind = 'INPUT') THEN '进项发票' WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fin_advance WHERE partner_id = #{id} AND kind = 'PAYMENT') THEN '预付款' END
